name: io.github.elibarnett/kie-mcp
description: Comprehensive MCP server for kie.ai — 45+ image models, 70+ video models, 20+ audio tools with built-in Averiguare model intelligence. Includes GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2/Pro, Flux Kontext, Veo 3.1, HappyHorse 1.0, Seedance 2.0, Sora 2, Kling 3.0, Wan 2.7, Suno, ElevenLabs, and more.

environment_variables.name: KIE_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Your kie.ai API key from https://kie.ai/api-key

environment_variables.name: KIE_PROJECT_ROOT
environment_variables.description: Directory where generated files are saved (under kie/assets/raw/). Defaults to current working directory.
